required_contract: Require one valid bucket and bind its exact value into the signed encryption target.
Preserve omission or sign one bounded control-free owner precondition exactly once.
Preserve absent body versus a present configuration and decode the required flattened Rules list.
Require at least one flattened Rule whenever the outer configuration is present.
Preserve optional default-encryption structure presence and its required algorithm.
Preserve optional exact Boolean presence without assigning a bucket-key policy.
Preserve optional blocked-types structure and flattened values within shared XML limits.
Require exactly one of the five pinned encryption algorithm values when the default structure is present.
Preserve omission or exact unbounded key identifier text.
Preserve the optional flattened NONE or SSE-C values in wire order.
